scripts.test:unit: node --import tsx --test tests\source-audit.test.ts tests\catalog-integrity.test.ts tests\search-ranking.test.ts tests\study-mode.test.ts
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && node --import tsx --test tests\browser-smoke.test.ts
scripts.test:evals: npm run test:unit && npm run test:mcp && npm run test:browser
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && cross-env INPUT=mcp-app.html vite build
scripts.start: concurrently --raw "cross-env NODE_ENV=development INPUT=mcp-app.html vite build --watch" "tsx watch main.ts"
scripts.dev: concurrently --raw "cross-env NODE_ENV=development INPUT=mcp-app.html vite build --watch" "tsx watch main.ts"
